newsItems.title: Groq raises $350M to fuel its pivot from AI chips to neocloud
newsItems.summary: Groq raised $350 million at a $3.5 billion valuation as the former AI chipmaker pivots to a neocloud business and expands its Nvidia-powered data center footprint.
newsItems.whyItMatters: 资金流向反映市场正在为哪些 AI 能力与商业模式下注。
newsItems.titleZh: Groq 融资 3.5 亿美元，推动从 AI 芯片转向 Neocloud
newsItems.summaryZh: Groq 以 35 亿美元的估值筹集了 3.5 亿美元，这家前 AI 芯片制造商转向 Neocloud 业务并扩大其由 Nvidia 驱动的数据中心业务。

newsItems.title: Amazon, once an online bookseller, is destroying rare books to train AI models
newsItems.summary: Rare books are incredibly valuable for training LLMs, since these models have already trained on whatever's available online.
newsItems.whyItMatters: 基础模型能力、价格和开放策略的变化，会迅速传导到整个应用生态。
newsItems.titleZh: 曾经的在线书商亚马逊正在销毁善本书籍来训练人工智能模型
newsItems.summaryZh: 善本对于培训法学硕士来说非常有价值，因为这些模型已经根据在线可用的任何内容进行了培训。
